newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Paring seen in Thai finance firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Paring seen in Thai finance firms.

text.p: Possible IMF involvement in managing the Thai economy will accelerate consolidation in the finance sector leaving a maximum 60 firms operational by the end of 1997, Thaimex Finance and Securities said on Wednesday.
Encouraging consolidation among the 91 companies in the ailing sector has been a cornerstone of government policy for six months but no successful mergers have yet been completed.

"With the IMF on the verge of wading in, it seems the only alternative to striking a deal (for ailing firms) is bankruptcy... If all goes well we will be seeing a maximum of 60 finance firms leftover by the end of 1997," Thaimex said in a report.
